subproblem.title: The weighted image of a bi-Lipschitz parameter piece under a Lipschitz map is an integer multiplicity current with the expected mass bound (Simon 6.3.5–3.9 on one injective piece; step 7 of the selected proof)
subproblem.statement: Assume (IMC), the exact frozen statement of the accepted DAG theorem cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub (tangent locality; restriction of an IMRep to a Borel set represents a current; differences of IM currents are IM; |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e. for IMReps). Let k, N' ∈ ℕ, H : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{N'} L-Lipschitz, A ⊆ ℝᵏ Borel, κ > 0 with κ|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for a, a' ∈ A, H differentiable with injective derivative at every point of A, and g : ℝᵏ → ℝ Borel, integer-valued at every point and nonzero at every point of A, with ∫⁻_A |g|·J_H dLᵏ < ∞ (J_H(u) := (det[⟨DH(u)e_a, DH(u)e_b⟩])^{1/2}, e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1). Then there is an integer multiplicity current Φ ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k) with M(Φ) ≤ ∫⁻_A |g|·J_H dLᵏ and Φ(ω) = ∫_A g(u)·ω(H(u))(DH(u)e_0, …, DH(u)e_{k−1}) du for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}).
subproblem.lean_statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (k N' : ℕ) (H : Euclid k → Euclid N') (A : Set (Euclid k)) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ) (g : Euclid k → ℝ), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet A → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → Measurable g → (∀ u, ∃ z : ℤ, g u = z) → (∀ u ∈ A, g u ≠ 0) → ∫⁻ u in A, ‖g u‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) ≠ ∞ → ∃ Φ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Φ ∧ Φ.mass ≤ ∫⁻ u in A, ‖g u‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, Φ ω = ∫ u in A, g u * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 7 of the selected proof, the construction of Φ_{il} = τ(H_i(A_{il}), |g_{il}|, sign(g_{il})η_{il}) (Simon Ch. 6, 3.5–3.9: on a piece where f is injective with J > 0 the push-forward is τ(f(M_+), θ∘f⁻¹, ±η) with η the induced orientation; chapter-06.txt lines 800–859). Notation: Hᵏ := μHE[k]; Lᵏ := volume on ℝᵏ; J := J_H; v(u) := (DH(u)e_a)_{a<k}; (IMC)(b), (IMC)(d) denote the second and fourth conjuncts of the antecedent.
1. The image and the area formula. H is continuous and injective on A (κ > 0), so N := H(A) is Borel (Lusin–Souslin, MeasurableSet.image_of_continuousOn_injOn). By the sibling gram_area_formula (codim1_lura_gram_area_formula) with f := H, s := A: J is Borel and ∫⁻_N φ dHᵏ = ∫⁻_A ofReal(J(u))·φ(H(u)) du for every φ ≥ 0; as in the sibling parametric_rep (step 7), this gives Hᵏ.restrict N = Measure.map H ((Lᵏ.restrict A).withDensity (ofReal ∘ J)) and ∫_N h dHᵏ = ∫_A J(u)·h(H(u)) du for every h integrable on N. In particular Hᵏ(N) = ∫⁻_A ofReal(J) ≤ ∫⁻_A |g|·ofReal(J) < ∞, because |g| ≥ 1 on A (a nonzero integer).
2. Inverse. ψ₀ := Function.invFunOn H A satisfies ψ₀(H(a)) = a for a ∈ A and is κ⁻¹-Lipschitz on N. Extend it to a Lipschitz, hence Borel, map ψ : ℝ^{N'} → ℝᵏ with ψ = ψ₀ on N (coordinatewise McShane extension LipschitzOnWith.extend_real / extend_pi, transported along the continuous linear equivalence EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) ≃ (Fin k → ℝ); any Borel extension suffices).
3. Orientation data. For u ∈ ℝᵏ let η(u) := J(u)⁻¹ • Ev(DH(u)) ∈ MultiVector N' k with Ev(T) := (ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid k) ℝ e).comp (ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM T), e := (fun a => EuclideanSpace.single a 1), so η(u)(α) = J(u)⁻¹·α(v(u)) (apply_apply, compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply); u ↦ η(u) is strongly measurable (fderiv is Borel with values in the finite-dimensional space ℝᵏ →L ℝ^{N'}, Ev is continuous by continuous_const.clm_comp ContinuousAlternatingMap.continuous_compContinuousLinearMapCLM, J is Borel, and StronglyMeasurable is preserved by continuous maps and scalar multiplication — as in step 6 of the sibling piece_orientation_sign). For a ∈ A, v(a) is linearly independent (DH(a) injective) and span(range v(a)) = range DH(a), so by the sibling normalized_wedge_orientation (codim1_lur_normalized_wedge_orientation): J(a) > 0 and η(a) is a unit orientation of range DH(a); so is −η(a) (swap the two alternatives in IsUnitOrientationOf).
4. The IMRep R'. Define on ℝ^{N'}: mult(y) := ⌊|g(ψ(y))|⌋₊ (Nat.floor) if y ∈ N and 0 otherwise — Borel (indicator of the Borel set N times the Borel function Nat.floor ∘ |g ∘ ψ|), and mult(H(a)) = |g(a)| ≥ 1 for a ∈ A since g is integer-valued and ψ(H(a)) = a; orient(y) := sgn(g(ψ(y)))·η(ψ(y)) with sgn(t) := 1 for t ≥ 0 and −1 for t < 0 — strongly measurable (composition of the strongly measurable η with the Borel ψ, times a Borel scalar), hence AEStronglyMeasurable. Fields of IMRep univ k: carrier N Borel and ⊆ univ; CountablyRectifiable k N (M₀ := ∅ and F_j := H for every j: N ⊆ range H, H Lipschitz); measurable_mult; mult_pos on N; locallyIntegrable_mult: ∫⁻_{N∩K} mult dHᵏ ≤ ∫⁻_N mult dHᵏ = ∫⁻_A ofReal(J)·|g| < ∞ (step 1 with φ := mult); orients: by the sibling piece_approx_tangent (dpf_approxTangent_ae_bilipschitz_piece) with U := univ, Y := N (Borel, Hᵏ(N ∩ C) ≤ Hᵏ(N) < ∞), F := H, B := A, m := κ, there is an Lᵏ-null Z ⊆ A such that HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k N (H a) (range DH(a)) for a ∈ A ∖ Z; H(Z) is Hᵏ-null (μHE[k](H(Z)) ≤ L^k·Lᵏ(Z) = 0, SimonGMT euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_le_of_lipschitzOn); for y = H(a) ∈ N ∖ H(Z): ψ(y) = a, N has approximate tangent space range DH(a) at y, and orient(y) = ±η(a) is a unit orientation of it (step 3). So orients holds (Hᵏ.restrict N)-a.e.
5. The current. By (IMC)(b) applied to R' and E := univ (U = univ is open) there are Φ ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) and an IMRep R'' with R''.Represents Φ, carrier(R'') = N ∩ univ = N, mult(R'') = mult, orient(R'') = orient. Hence Φ is integer multiplicity and Φ(ω) = R''.action(ω) = R'.action(ω) for every ω (IMRep.action depends only on carrier, mult and orient).
6. The action. Let ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and h(y) := mult(y)·orient(y)(ω(y)). h is AEStronglyMeasurable (pairing via isBoundedBilinearMap_apply as in step 9(a) of the sibling parametric_rep). ω is continuous with compact support, so ‖ω(y)‖ ≤ C_ω; unit orientations have norm ≤ 1, so |h| ≤ C_ω·mult (Hᵏ.restrict N)-a.e., and h is integrable on N (step 1). By step 1, R'.action(ω) = ∫_N h dHᵏ = ∫_A J(a)·mult(H a)·orient(H a)(ω(H a)) da = ∫_A J(a)·|g(a)|·sgn(g(a))·J(a)⁻¹·ω(H a)(v(a)) da = ∫_A g(a)·ω(H(a))(DH(a)e) da, using ψ(H(a)) = a, |g|·sgn(g) = g and J(a) > 0 on A.
7. The mass. Let ω be admissible for M(Φ) = Φ.massOn univ, i.e. covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x. By (IMC)(d) for R'', |orient(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm(α) for (Hᵏ.restrict N)-a.e. x and all α, so Φ(ω) = ∫_N mult·orient(ω) dHᵏ ≤ ∫_N mult dHᵏ = (∫⁻_A |g|·ofReal(J)).toReal, hence ofReal(Φ(ω)) ≤ ∫⁻_A ‖g‖ₑ·ofReal(J). Since M(Φ) is the supremum of ofReal(Φ(ω)) over admissible ω (sSup_le), M(Φ) ≤ ∫⁻_A ‖g(u)‖ₑ·ofReal(J(u)) du. ∎
proof_key_steps: N = H(A) is Borel; codim1_lura_gram_area_formula identifies Hᵏ⌞N with the image of J_H·Lᵏ⌞A, so Hᵏ(N) ≤ ∫⁻_A|g|J_H < ∞.
With the Borel inverse ψ of H|_A, set mult = |g∘ψ| and orient = sgn(g∘ψ)·η∘ψ, η(u) = J_H(u)⁻¹(α ↦ α(DH(u)e)) a unit orientation of range DH(u) (codim1_lur_normalized_wedge_orientation).
dpf_approxTangent_ae_bilipschitz_piece (Y = N) plus Lipschitz images of null sets give the orients field: (N, mult, orient) is an IMRep in ℝ^{N'}.
(IMC)(b) turns the IMRep into an IM current Φ; the area formula gives Φ(ω) = ∫_A g·ω(H)(DH e).
(IMC)(d) bounds |orient(α)| by the coefficient norm, so M(Φ) ≤ ∫_N mult dHᵏ = ∫⁻_A|g|J_H.

audit.reason: The proof constructs all IMRep fields using the measurable inverse, normalized derivative wedge and tangent theorem. The exact IMC antecedent supplies a represented current and the coefficient-norm bound; the area formula proves both its action and mass estimate.
